Name: Custom Localization
Author: ZaneYork
Description:
Custom Localization is a Localization Mod for Stardew Valley Android only.
It allow you to custom game's language select button and add new localization selection.

[b]Description[/b]
0.For Android Stardew Valley only.
1.Extract mod into Mods folder.
2.put localization xnb resources into Content folder.

The mod will load Content folder and add or replace xnb files into game's own content dynamically without needs of modify game's apk.


Source code is available on [url=https://github.com/ZaneYork/SDV_CustomLocalization]github﻿[/url].

Downloads.Description: Change patch mode to make it available for other platform
